name: music_visualizers
description: Listening test: per-line visualizers using Strudel syntax — open Ctrl+M to watch
script: announce VISUALIZER TESTS — watch the Music Drawer (Ctrl+M)
strudel edit "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() cps=0.5
strudel edit "c3 e3 g3 c4".scope() cps=0.5
announce 3/6: wordfall — vertical pianoroll with labels
announce 6/6: All types — one per line
strudel edit melody: "c4 e4 g4 c5".pianoroll() | bass: "c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~".scope() | chords: "[c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4]".spiral() cps=0.4
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the visualizers look?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
